description: Header file defining structures and function prototypes for the fetch-pack component in a Git-like version control system, including fetch arguments, pack negotiation, and object integrity checks.

methods.name: fetch_pack
methods.description: Performs the fetch operation based on provided arguments, handling pack negotiation and object retrieval.

methods.name: negotiate_using_fetch
methods.description: Executes negotiation-only mode of fetch, adding known common commits to acknowledged set.

methods.name: report_unmatched_refs
methods.description: Reports refs that were not matched during fetch, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: fetch_pack_fsck_objects
methods.description: Checks if broken objects in received pack need to be verified.

methods.name: fetch_pack_fsck_config
methods.description: Processes fetch fsck configuration variables and appends relevant info to message buffer.
